name: Annapurna Swadisht Limited
summary: Annapurna Swadisht Ltd. is an Indian packaged food and FMCG company making affordable snacks and foods such as fryums, namkeen, bhujia, cakes, biscuits, noodles, candies and ready-to-drink beverages. It recently added confectionery through an acquisition. Its main markets are rural and semi-urban areas of Eastern and North India, including West Bengal, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
